DROP_ALL_CONFIRM:
%s %s · ×%s

Every copy leaves your inventory and its slot is free at once. The stack waits on the ground for 5 minutes: tap it to pick it up again (Auto-Collect never takes it back). Picking it up again gives no mission, Prestige or Mastery progress.
SKILL_DESC_HEAL: Heals you %s HP now (%s HP, at most %s%% of max HP) when you are below %s%% HP
SKILL_DESC_FOCUS: +%s%% attack damage for 5 s (+%s damage per hit now) · only in combat
SKILL_DESC_FROST: %s× attack damage (%s now) to every enemy within %s of you, and slows them 25%% for 3 s
SKILL_DESC_FIRE: %s× attack damage (%s now) to your target and every enemy within %s of it
SKILL_DESC_LIGHTNING: %s× attack damage (%s now) to your current target
SKILL_DESC_STRIKE: %s× attack damage (%s now) to your current target, a heavy close-range hit
HEAL_ROLE_SHORT: Free sustain between potions. Damage numbers above are before enemy Defense; skill cards and merges raise them.
PRESTIGE_CONFIRM_SUBTITLE: Redeem %d opportunit(ies) and begin a new run
PRESTIGE_CONFIRM_REDEEM: You choose one permanent card for each:
PRESTIGE_CONFIRM_NOTE: Cards are chosen one at a time and saved at once. The run restarts on Winter I after the last card.

KEEP_LINE_UPGRADES: Every Gem upgrade, automation and inventory space
KEEP_LINE_PROGRESS: Boss keys, enemy achievements, supply mastery and Map Mastery

PRESTIGE_KEEP: Cards and sets, your Gems, explored map areas, every upgrade bought with gems (all categories), automation, inventory space, boss keys, enemy achievements, supply mastery, Map Mastery and settings.
PRESTIGE_RESET: Coins, items (supply stock included) and merges, level, map access and owned camps, map and coin upgrades and unfinished challenges.
PRESTIGE_REQ_BOSS: Find the Winter I Snowman (first boss)
PRESTIGE_LOCKED_FIRST_BOSS: Find the Winter I Snowman (the first boss) to unlock the Prestige reset.
GUIDE_SNOWMAN_DETAIL: Defeating it opens Winter II; finding it opens Prestige. Merge gear, level up and bring potions first.
GUIDE_FEATURE_OBJECTIVE_DETAIL: Defeating it opens Winter II; finding it opens Prestige. Merge gear, level up and bring potions first.
GUIDE_MOVE: Follow the path to your left.
GUIDE_MOVE_DETAIL: Drag the joystick toward the arrow. The first enemies wait along the path.
GUIDE_CAMP_VIEW_DETAIL: It opens this camp, where you can unlock it.
GUIDE_CAMP_DETAIL: You have found a camp and can afford it. Open World, or walk to the camp and tap View Camp.
CAMP_HELP: Camps are respawn points. Rest beside an unlocked camp to recover quickly.
HELP_INTRO: The tutorial cards for everything you have unlocked so far. Reading them changes nothing in your game.
AUDIO_HINT: Gameplay sounds: taps, purchases, merges and combat. Special sounds: notifications (a mission or objective ready to claim, Prestige news, a new menu, Map Mastery progress, a boss found) and milestones (a new map, a Prestige). The sound-effect volume sets both.
